concerns: tests/test_models.py::TestDocument::test_document_holds_no_wording lists the concrete fields of Document as {id, name, slug, kind} and fails for any new field. It is not a test this story wrote, so it was not changed. The edit it needs is to add "enforced" to that set. This is the only test failing in the full suite (1 failed, 597 passed), and it is what leaves T003 and T005 blocked.

specs/010-site-wide-agreement-check/US2-brief.json is committed without a final newline, so the end-of-file-fixer hook in uv run pre-commit run --all-files, and so the lint step of forge verify, fails on it and rewrites it. The base commit's lint passed before that file was added. The file was not touched; the rewrite verify made was reverted with git checkout.

T003 and T005 are not recorded done in feature-state.json: both are reported blocked and forge ledger-task has no way to record a blocked task, so their rows still read todo, attempts 0, although their code is committed (bb3651d, 36d4f5b). T002 and T004 are recorded done.
